description: We are a passionate team interested in space, technology, and innovation. We love solving challenges through creative ideas and teamwork. We welcome members skilled in Python, AI/ML, web development, research, and creative thinking who are eager to learn and innovate together!
summary: We developed Earth Trend Detective, an AI-powered website that analyzes environmental changes using NASA Earth science data. It identifies increasing and decreasing trends in variables like temperature, rainfall, and vegetation across regions. Our project simplifies complex environmental data, promotes climate awareness, and supports better decision-making for a sustainable future.
details:
Our project, Earth System Trend Detective, is designed to help people understand changes happening on Earth by studying environmental data. It focuses on showing information such as temperature and helping users understand environmental trends in a simple way.

We developed the frontend to make the website easy to use and the backend to handle the processing and connection of data. We used VS Code and Python during development. Our aim is to make environmental information easier for everyone to understand, even without technical knowledge.

What makes our project useful is its simple approach to presenting environmental information. Through this project, we want to encourage people to learn more about Earth's changing conditions and the importance of protecting our environment.
